name: openstory
description: Mint a library style from refs (create-style), turn a script into a multi-scene AI video (create-sequence), play a cut from clips, stills, and a music bed (stitch), and connect the OpenStory MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Scripts in, multi-scene AI video out
interface.longDescription: Mint a library style from refs, turn a script into a multi-scene AI video, and share a cut of clips, stills, and a music bed. Installing the plugin also connects the hosted OpenStory MCP server at https://openstory.so/mcp. Sign-in is OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Turn this script into an OpenStory sequence
Mint an OpenStory style from these references
Which OpenStory team am I signed in as?
